extras: Warning: Updating from version 1.5 or below to 1.6 will erase snippets; users must back them up.
intentEvidence: There is an existing snippets plugin already, Text Snippets by ArianaKhit, but not only is the plugin code somewhat outdated and a little complex
motivation: The author wanted to create a generic snippets plugin that operated on text and worked as needed, and to implement their personal note-taking syntax (JellyNote).
problem: Users need a straightforward way to insert predefined text blocks or phrases into their notes using simple triggers.

relations.evidence: There is an existing snippets plugin already, Text Snippets by ArianaKhit, but not only is the plugin code somewhat outdated and a little complex
This plugin also reminds me of LaTeX2Unicode, a neovim plugin which I used extensively in my first two years of college.

summary: A simple text snippets plugin that allows users to define mappings between specific text patterns and replacement strings for quick text expansion.
